summary: The marketing team is in a critical execution phase, balancing the redesign of the knowledge website with SEO-focused promotion of Asia Star and Intelligent China, while advancing the China Going-Global report and BSI data, and preparing for the TIA conference.
summaryDetail: Priority is on the knowledge website redesign, which is awaiting feedback on Joseph's design to incorporate more articles and indices on the homepage, with Joker ready to adjust based on input. Simultaneously, SEO and program promotion are focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting target areas and prompts, and the team analyzing participant data to define audiences. The China Going-Global report is progressing, with feedback on key pages due from Ira and consolidation by Tian, while BSI chart data is being uploaded and the report translation reviewed before sharing with professors. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding the account, and provide feedback on Joseph's design to keep the redesign on track. Upcoming: finalize TIA conference topics and materials, update the Indonesia program webpage, and decide on adding two additional indices to the BSI chart.
